record.paper_title: String Theory on ADS3: Some Open Questions
record.original_question: For a string propagating on three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space with an NS–NS two-form, so that the worldsheet sigma model is the SU(1,1) Wess–Zumino–Witten model, how can one construct a complete perturbative spectrum of physical string states that is consistent with the basic requirements of string theory and conformal field theory?

evidence.quote: Despite the progress made in various directions, several quite elementary questions remain unanswered, in particular in the very simple case of three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space.

I will very briefly review these problems, discuss in some detail the important issue of constructing a consistent spectrum for a string propagating on ADS3 plus torsion background, and comment on potential solutions.

As far as string theory is concerned, ADS3 is an exact background, provided an NS–NS two-form is switched on. In fact, three-dimensional anti-de Sitter space is the universal covering of the SU(1,1) group manifold, and the corresponding two-dimensional conformally invariant sigma model is a Wess–Zumino–Witten model.
No satisfactory understanding of its basic features, such as the complete spectrum of perturbative states, has yet been reached.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider bosonic string theory propagating on three-dimensional anti–de Sitter space AdS₃ with a nontrivial NS–NS two-form (Kalb–Ramond) background whose field strength is proportional to the volume form. Because AdS₃ is the universal cover of the group manifold SU(1,1) ≅ SL(2,ℝ), the worldsheet sigma model is the SL(2,ℝ) (equivalently SU(1,1)) Wess–Zumino–Witten model at some level k > 2.

Construct a complete perturbative spectrum of physical string states for this background. Concretely:

(a) Identify the set of unitary representations of the affine sl(2,ℝ)_k current algebra (and its right-moving copy) that must appear in the worldsheet Hilbert space, including their precise ranges of Casimir/spin labels.

(b) Impose the Virasoro (physical state) conditions and exhibit the resulting spectrum of physical states, ensuring that:
   (i) no negative-norm (ghost) states survive (no-ghost theorem),
   (ii) the spacetime energy is bounded below,
   (iii) the worldsheet partition function on the torus is modular invariant.

(c) Combine left- and right-movers into a consistent closed-string Hilbert space and verify that the resulting spectrum is compatible with the basic requirements of string theory and two-dimensional conformal field theory.

The problem is to give such a construction explicitly and justify its consistency.
artifact.category_tag: AdS3 string theory and SL(2,R) WZW model
artifact.status_search_result: Maldacena and Ooguri (hep-th/0001053, 2000) proposed a complete spectrum of the SL(2,ℝ)_k WZW model built from continuous and discrete unitary representations together with all their spectral-flow images (winding sectors), proving a no-ghost theorem and constructing a modular-invariant partition function (verified in Part II, hep-th/0005183). Correlation functions were analyzed in Part III (hep-th/0111180). This proposal is widely accepted as the resolution of the spectrum problem and has been developed further in subsequent work (e.g., JHEP 2023, JHEP 2024).

status_evidence.title: Strings in AdS_3 and the SL(2,R) WZW Model. Part 1: The Spectrum
status_evidence.snippet: Studies classical solutions including long strings with winding, the spectral-flow symmetry, and constructs the Hilbert space including all states related by this symmetry.
status_evidence.claim: Proposes a complete spectrum for strings on AdS3 using SL(2,R) WZW representations together with spectral flow.

status_evidence.title: Strings in AdS_3 and the SL(2,R) WZW Model. Part 2: Euclidean Black Hole
status_evidence.snippet: Computes the one-loop partition function on Euclidean BTZ, finding modular-invariant results consistent with the spectrum of Part I.
status_evidence.claim: Verifies the modular invariance and consistency of the proposed spectrum.

status_evidence.title: Strings in AdS_3 and the SL(2,R) WZW Model. Part 3: Correlation Functions
status_evidence.snippet: Considers correlation functions for string theory on AdS3 and analyzes their singularities.
status_evidence.claim: Completes the construction of the theory at the level of correlation functions.
